name: Dundee Hills

climate: Seasons this cool ripen Pinot Gris, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Müller-Thurgau and Gewürztraminer fully without cooking off their freshness.
Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

soil.rock: Volcanic rock is porous, so it drains well and sends roots deep. Lava soils are mostly basalt, rich in iron, calcium and magnesium. Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Much of it is steep. Cold air and rain run off, so frost and waterlogging are rare and soils stay thin, keeping yields low. Steep rows are slow and costly to work, often by hand.

winkler: Only very early grapes ripen well, mostly hybrids and a few vinifera.

sheet.soil: Red Jory clay, from volcanic basalt, deep and well drained.
sheet.elevation: 200 to 1,067 feet. This vineyard sits near 380.

claims.claim: The Dundee Hills AVA was approved in 2004, as Oregon's eighth AVA.
The name started as a proposed 'Red Hills', for the red soil. The petition was amended to Dundee Hills.
Jory soil covers about 80 percent of the AVA. It is a red, well-drained volcanic clay.
Jory formed from Columbia River basalt lava flows more than 14 million years ago. It runs 4 to 6 feet deep.
The steeper western slopes have Willakenzie soils, a sedimentary soil, rather than Jory.
Vineyards run from the 200 foot contour up to a high point of 1,067 feet.
The Coast Range to the west puts the Dundee Hills in a rain shadow. Rain is 30 to 45 inches a year.
Nights are warmer and frost is less likely than on the valley floor. Growing seasons run a little warmer than most Willamette Valley AVAs.
Pinot Noir from Jory is often bright and elegant, with earthy, truffle-like flavors and a silky feel.
